subject: JarvisCloud IAM artifacts and SCIM delta handoff
messages:
From: Maya Hoffman <maya.hoffman@jarviscloud.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Priyom,

We're in the last round of our SIG questionnaire review and need a handful of IAM artifacts from Redwood to complete the access-control section. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by Tue, Nov 23 EOD?:

- Representative SAML assertion samples (NameID formats, attributes used)
- SCIM delta export for the last 30 days (create/update/delete events)
- Current RBAC role definitions and a role->privilege mapping (JSON or CSV)
- Short note on least-privilege proofs/process (how you validate role assignments)

If you can provide a zipped package or Drive link that would be ideal. Also let me know if we need an NDA or data handling agreement to receive logs.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Hoffman
Security & Compliance, JarvisCloud
Maya: +1-415-555-0123

--
P.S. Please cc security+audit@jarviscloud.com on replies.

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Maya Hoffman <maya.hoffman@jarviscloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested; outline below is our proposed deliverables and timing. Please flag anything that isn't acceptable.

Deliverables (target delivery Tue, Nov 22 EOD):
- SAML assertion samples: a small set of redacted assertions showing NameID formats + attribute mapping (TXT)
- SCIM delta: CSV containing the last 30 days of change events (timestamp, op, user_id, source_system)
- RBAC snapshot: role definitions + attached privilege mapping (JSON)
- Process note: short doc describing least-privilege review cadence and owner

Questions for you:
1) Are CSV logs acceptable, or do you need a different format?
2) Any specific redaction rules we should follow for email/user identifiers?
3) Do you require an NDA/DP agreement before we share SCIM deltas?

I'll attach an internal plan (iam_evidence_plan_v1.docx) to track the handoff and redaction steps. Laura, Marcus — FYI, I'll coordinate the artifacts and drop in Drive.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-9876

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maya Hoffman <maya.hoffman@jarviscloud.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2027 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Maya — quick clarification from the SAML side: our common NameID formats are email and persistent (eduPersonTargetedID-style). For SIG review we'll include examples showing both. We'll redact local part of email addresses (e.g., j***@example.com) unless you prefer full emails.

Attached: saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 assertions: email NameID, persistent NameID, service-account assertion).

On SCIM: our export tool can produce a delta CSV with columns: event_time, operation, external_id, user_email, source, actor. We can redact user_email to domain-only (***@example.com). Please confirm redaction preference.

Also: do you need a service-account inventory? If so, let us know the format (we can provide a short CSV).

Laura Bennett
Security & Privacy Programs | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: saml_assertion_samples.txt (attachment stub)

From: Maya Hoffman <maya.hoffman@jarviscloud.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: security+audit@jarviscloud.com
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Thanks Laura/Priyom — that format sounds good. A few quick answers:
- CSV is fine for SCIM deltas; domain-only redaction for user_email is acceptable.
- Yes, please include a service-account inventory (CSV) with owner and last-used timestamp.
- No NDA required for these redacted artifacts; however, we will store them in our vendor vault and limit access.

If you can include a short note about your RBAC owner/process (who approves role requests, periodic reviews), that will satisfy the CAIQ question. Delivery by Tue EOD works for us.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Maya

--
